_comment: Expectations for bench/src/lines.rs and tmrport.rs kernels (plumb_lines and the ported TMR tests). Width rules come from the _128/_256/_512 suffix rules in asm_check.py. Twins: each plumb-style kernel's innermost loops must be within 25% of its TMR-style twin in instructions per key memory op (load, store, nt, flush, movdir64b). loop_forbid: GPR<->vector moves and lane shuffles in a positional loop mean the index vector is being rebuilt every iteration.

expect._why: per-line flush_line is asm!: its address is a register operand, so one lea per line that the intrinsic twin folds into a displacement (flush_line docs)

expect.known: footgun on purpose: NT scope in a plain generic fn, no #[simd]; every op is a call
